title: Effects
summary: Run code after React has updated the page with useEffect, and choose when it runs with the dependency array. You will watch the effect land after the re-render flash, see the wrong dependency array leave the page stale, save the product list to localStorage, and clean up a timer so that a later change cannot be cut short by an earlier one.
changeNote: Rewritten so each step opens with an explainer or a prediction, folds the background under Read more, and ends with a quiz.
